checked_scope: The star-network exponential-drift argument and the distinction between prefix and window regret.
checks: Under the declared admission/service/arrival order, total source-plus-buffer load obeys W_(t+1)=(W_t-D_t)^++A_t. Work conservation ensures service availability exactly when total load is positive, independent of priority.
For positive W, exponential multiplier q(theta) has q(0)=1 and qprime(0)=sum lambda_i-mu<0. A bounded zero-state contribution then yields a uniform exponential moment; equality slack is not asserted.

Bad windows at 4^k of length 2^k occupy <2sqrt(T) prefix time and give pathwise sublinear state-held-fixed one-step regret. During each bad window expected arrivals minus potential service >=(lambda-epsilon)2^k, so expected backlog is unbounded. These windows violate the stronger uniform-window premise.
